jobs.title: Corporate Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 


About the Role: 
Reporting to the Director of Strategy, the Corporate Strategy Manager will serve as the core quantitative and analytical engine of the Strategy function. This role owns financial and market modeling, competitor tracking, and project-based strategic initiatives across Lyra's business units.



Responsibilities
-
Quantitative Modeling & Unit Economics: Build financial models, P&L forecasts, and unit economics frameworks to guide portfolio investment decisions and evaluate growth opportunities.

-
Competitive Intelligence & Trends: Perform continuous syntheses of market trends, regulatory shifts, and competitor maneuvers, turning raw data into actionable recommendations for product and market entry teams.

-
Strategic Initiative Execution: Manage day-to-day strategic workstreams supporting M&A target evaluation, 'build vs. buy vs. partner' decisions, and cross-vertical strategic priorities.

-
Annual Planning Support: Structure data collection and analytical inputs to power the annual strategic planning cadence.

-
Executive Presentation Build: Translate complex analytical findings into structured, visual PowerPoint narratives for executive presentation.
Qualifications
-
5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, healthcare investment banking, or strategy & operations in a high-growth tech/healthtech setting.

-
Exceptional quantitative and financial modeling capabilities (Excel/Google Sheets) with experience structuring complex datasets.

-
Strong narrative development and visual deck-building skills.

-
Healthcare industry exposure (digital health, employer benefits, or health plans) is strongly preferred.

-
Bachelor’s degree required; top-tier management consulting background preferred.

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. About The Role
We are seeking an experienced Director of Operations – Provider Performance to establish and execute a holistic provider performance strategy across all of Lyra’s clinical service lines. In this role, you will lead a high-impact team operating at the intersection of clinical strategy, data analytics, and operational execution. Your mandate is to optimize provider performance which will further drive clinical quality, client access to care, and business results.
As a strategic player-coach, you will partner closely with Service Line leaders, Clinical Operations, and Data Analytics to build scalable data infrastructure, operational tools, and executive reporting. You will translate complex performance insights into actionable dashboards and operational systems that drive data visibility for providers, managers and executive leadership.

What You’ll Do:
-
Strategic Vision & Roadmap Ownership: Define and execute a holistic provider performance vision, establishing standardized, scalable frameworks across all clinical service lines

-
Team Leadership & Scale: Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing operations team. Set high-impact priorities and support professional development for direct reports.

-
Data Vision & Analytics Governance: Partner directly with the Data Analytics team to build a unified data vision. Establish centralized systems to measure, track, and predict provider availability, capacity, and performance across diverse employment models

-
Systems & Tooling Execution: Oversee the development of operational tools, workflows, and cross-program dashboards that empower clinical managers to drive day-to-day performance and provide executive leadership with real-time visibility

-
Strategic Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as a core operational partner to senior leadership on strategic growth initiatives, with an immediate focus on optimizing provider availability, network utilization, and productivity across our Adult Outpatient Service Line
Requirements:
-
Core Requirement — Provider Performance Experience : 5+ years of direct, hands-on experience designing, scaling, or managing provider performance operations, clinical productivity frameworks, or provider network operations within a healthcare organization, health tech company, or large provider network .

-
15+ years of experience in business operations, management consulting, healthcare operations, or high-growth health tech; experience scaling complex operations preferred.

-
8+ years of direct people management experience, with a track record of scaling high-performing teams and building strong team cultures.

-
Domain Knowledge of Provider Metrics: Deep understanding of clinical network operations and core provider metrics (e.g., panel management, utilization rates, clinical outcome tracking)

-
Data & Analytics Expertise: Proven ability to scope analytical frameworks, synthesize complex data sets, and partner effectively with analytics teams to translate raw data into operational tools and dashboards.

-
Executive Influence: Demonstrated experience building strategic roadmaps and aligning executive leadership, clinical leaders, and cross-functional teams around shared outcomes.

-
Execution & Change Management: A self-starter who thrives in ambiguous environments, with a proven ability to turn complex, disparate processes into standardized, scalable systems.

-
Mission Alignment: Passionate about expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based mental health care.

Possess excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with senior-level client stakeholders. You can skillfully adjust your communication style for different audiences to influence coordinated action;

-

-

We are seeking a strategic Operations Manager to join our Provider Core Ops Systems Implementation team. In this role, you will lead and scale our Systems Architecture team, driving the operational strategy and multi-system integrations that power Lyra’s provider network platform. You will serve as the bridge between business strategy and technical execution, partnering directly with Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Operations leaders to solve complex infrastructure challenges and ensure seamless, sustainable data flows across provider-facing systems.
Core Focus Areas
Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and empower a high-performing team of Systems Architecture leads and individual contributors.
Architectural Ownership: Independently own complex cross-system integrations and multi-tool data pipelines across Workday, Salesforce, and downstream platforms.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Translate Clinical and Operations strategy into actionable technical roadmaps while resolving cross-departmental bottlenecks.

Responsibilities:
-
People Management & Operational Leadership: Serve as direct people manager to an operational team within Provider Core Ops. Develop tactical team plans, delegate work effectively, drive team performance against service line metrics, and invest in team culture and career development.

-
Architectural Ownership & Integration: Independently direct the operational strategy for complex tool integrations and data pipelines, ensuring system stability, scalability, and high data integrity across all provider-facing platforms.

-
Cross-Functional Strategic Unblocking: Partner closely with Product, Salesforce Development, Clinical, and Operations leadership to surface risks, resolve departmental tensions, and clear execution roadblocks for your team.

-
Operational Planning & Execution: Develop, prioritize, and adjust team roadmaps aligned with broader Provider Core Ops goals. Drive medium-to-large cross-functional initiatives from scope to delivery.

-
Operational Reporting & System Health: Monitor operational health metrics, evaluate platform performance, and surface automation opportunities to inform long-term infrastructure investments.
Qualifications:
-
Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in Operations Management, Systems Architecture, Business Operations, Program Management, or a related technical-ops function within a high-growth environment.

-
People Leadership: Proven track record as a direct people manager with demonstrated success setting operational roadmaps, delegating effectively, and mentoring team members.

-
Technical & Systems Acumen: Deep experience with enterprise tool ecosystems (Salesforce, Workday, Jira, Zendesk, CredentialStream, etc.) and direct experience managing multi-system data flows and integrations.

-
Strategic & XFN Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to balance granular technical details with executive-level strategy while influencing cross functional stakeholders.

-
Operational Insight: Strong analytical acumen and fluency with operational metrics to evaluate team performance and streamline system workflows.

jobs.description:
About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. 


About the Role: 
The Sr. Accounting Transformation Lead is responsible for supporting the SVP, Global Controller to advance the maturity, scalability, and effectiveness of the company's accounting operating model. This role will partner closely with the global leadership team to identify, prioritize, plan and execute accounting transformational initiatives that support the company's growth and long-term strategic objectives.
With the Global Controller, this leader will co-develop and drive accounting transformation spanning organizational design, process standardization, technology enablement, public-company readiness. The successful candidate will combine proven experience in accounting and strategy development, change management, operational excellence.  Sr. Accounting Transformation Lead should have exceptional project management skills along with exceptional communication experience and demonstrated success with delivering excellence for stakeholders.

Responsibilities
Accounting Transformation Strategy

-
Assess current-state capabilities across people, processes, technology, data, governance, and controls and identify opportunities to strengthen the accounting operating model.

-
Translate strategic priorities into project plans with measurable objectives, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and expected business outcomes.

Process Excellence & Global Standardization

-
Identify opportunities to simplify, harmonize, automate, and strengthen core accounting processes, including record-to-report, financial close, reconciliations, consolidation, intercompany accounting, financial reporting, and other controllership activities.

-
Manage the development of clearly defined roles, responsibilities, policies, procedures, and performance expectations.

-
Partner with accounting leaders to reduce manual processes, eliminate unnecessary complexity, improve close efficiency, and strengthen the quality and timeliness of financial information.

Technology Automation

-
Identify opportunities to leverage automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, workflow solutions to improve efficiency, accuracy, controls, and decision-making.

-
Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize investments, and ensure successful design and implementation of finance technology solutions.

-
Promote simplification and standardization of systems and data while reducing reliance on fragmented tools and manual processes.

Public Company Readiness

-
Project manage the critical accounting readiness activities associated with SEC-compliant financial reporting, disclosure processes, close and reporting timelines, supporting documentation, and reporting governance.

-
Identify and assist in resolving gaps that could impact IPO timing or sustainable public-company operations.

Change Leadership

-
Provide clear, concise reporting to senior leadership regarding transformation priorities, progress, risks, decisions, and resource requirements.

-
Lead change-management efforts necessary to drive adoption of new processes, technologies, organizational structures, and ways of working.

-
Build strong relationships across functions and geographies and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

-
Promote continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence across the global Accounting organization.
Qualifications
-
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field; CPA strongly preferred.

-
Approximately 12+ years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, finance transformation, with significant leadership experience in complex, high-growth organizations.

-
Experience leading large-scale Finance or Accounting transformation initiatives involving multiple functions, geographies, systems, and stakeholders.

-
Demonstrated experience redesigning and standardizing accounting processes and operating models.

-
Strong understanding of finance technology ecosystems, including ERP, consolidation, financial reporting, close management, reconciliation, workflow, automation, and data/analytics solutions.

-
Prior experience in public accounting and/or a large, complex multinational organization is a plus.
